ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Corruption in the Trump Administration
ideas.description: This story would investigate allegations of corruption and fraud in the Trump administration, including the use of funding freezes to divert funds.
questions: What are the motivations behind the funding freeze?
How has the Trump administration used funding freezes to divert funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and fraud in the Trump administration. By following the money and investigating the use of funding freezes, we may be able to expose a larger scheme.
